image-generation.prompt-elaborate:
A 45-year-old Italian woman (use Elena Higgsfield reference), lived-in face with subtle expression lines, warm brown shoulder-length hair pulled back in low ponytail. Standing in a clean modern home corner with a small dumbbell visible on a side table or floor (single 5kg dumbbell, NOT in gym setting). She wears a fitted black athletic short-sleeve top and casual sweat shorts (hint of recent or upcoming workout, but at HOME).
Her stance is grounded confident, weight on both legs, arms relaxed at sides. She looks at camera with direct strong expression - "let me tell you what changed everything for me" coach energy.
Camera: iPhone 15 Pro vertical shot, eye level, subject distance 110cm (medium shot upper body), neutral straight-on angle.
Light: single soft window light from camera-left at 30°, color temperature 5000K (clean midday), subtle ambient bounce.
Expression: Italian "lo sguardo del 'sto per cambiarti la testa'" - left eyebrow micro-raised 3mm, mouth slight knowing smile right corner up 4mm, eyes direct laser camera. Slight chin tilt UP 2° for authority.
Aesthetic reference: Modern Italian fitness coach 2026, contemporary realism. NOT cinematic. NOT golden hour.
Body: real Italian woman 45, AVERAGE proportions with subtle muscle tone (consistent with someone who lifts moderately - real, not exaggerated). Real arms with natural definition NOT bodybuilder. Important: looks STRONG but not "huge".
Color grading: neutral white balance + 3% warmth max, slight saturation on the dumbbell metal and her black top.
Composition: subject center frame, dumbbell visible lower-third (clear "I lift weights" signal), plenty of clean negative space top 18% and bottom 18% for brand overlay.
image-generation.negative-prompt: cinematic editorial, gym setting commercial, bodybuilder body, model thin, fitness influencer pose, instagram filter, beauty retouch, makeup heavy, golden hour, dramatic
